_note: Our own mission hook templates (src/story/mission_hooks.gd). A briefing sets the goal and the stakes (Core p.40). 'sitreps' = which generated sitreps fit (data/game/gm/missions.json). Text fields are line lists; one variant is picked. {patron} = who asked, {target} / {place} / {cargo} are filled from the lists below and COMP/CON's name lists. success/failure effects use StoryEffects. 'board' = whether it shows on the hub's job board by itself (others only come from story events). 'question' = the stakes as a question, the way the book frames them (Core p.43). 'hazardous' = getting there means crossing hostile ground: a skill challenge at the briefing unless the squad brought a Supplies reserve (Core p.47, p.51). Templates follow the kinds of goals in the book's goal table (Core p.42), written in our own words. 'cultures' = only offered at hubs of those kits. 'tutorial' = the guided first mission.

title: Convoy to {place}
Safe Passage
The Long Haul
Running the Road
objective: Get the convoy through {place}.
Escort {cargo} past {place} in one piece.
See the supply trucks safely through {place}.
stakes: If the convoy falls, {hub} goes hungry this season.
Lose the trucks and I lose everything I've put into this.
The convoy carries medicine. People die if it doesn't arrive.
question: Will the convoy reach {hub}, or will {enemy} pick it apart at {place}?

title: Hold {place}
Nobody Gets Through
Last Light at {place}
The Line
objective: Hold {place} until relief arrives.
Keep {enemy} off {place}.
Defend {place} for as long as it takes.
stakes: If {place} falls, {enemy} have a straight road into {hub}.
I've promised the people here that the line will hold.
Lose it and the whole valley's water goes with it.
question: Can the squad hold {place} until relief comes?

title: Hit the Depot
Burn the Stores
Supply Line Raid
Knock Out {place}
objective: Take the depot {enemy} hold at {place}.
Seize the supply caches {enemy} have stashed at {place}.
Break the grip {enemy} have on {place}.
stakes: Without those supplies, {enemy} can't keep up the pressure on {hub}.
I want this done before {enemy} can dig in.
If the raid fails, {enemy} will know exactly who sent you.
question: Will the raid break {enemy}, or tip them off?

title: Lost and Found
Recovery Run
What Fell at {place}
Salvage Job
objective: Recover {cargo} from {place}.
Find the lost shipment of {cargo} near {place} and bring it back.
Get to the wreck at {place} before {enemy} strip it.
stakes: I need that cargo back, and no questions asked.
Whoever holds the cargo holds {hub}'s future.
If {enemy} get there first, they'll sell it to the highest bidder.
question: Will the squad get to the {cargo} before {enemy} do?

title: Clear the Road
Raider Problem
Quiet {place}
Pest Control
objective: Drive {enemy} away from {place}.
Break the {enemy} who've been hitting {place}.
Clear {place} of {enemy}.
stakes: Every week {enemy} stay, another farm empties.
I'm out of patience, and out of other options.
If they're not stopped, {enemy} will come for {hub} next.
question: Can the squad end the raids on {place}, and find out who's paying {enemy}?

title: Bring Them Home
Search and Rescue
Past the Perimeter
No One Left Behind
objective: Find the missing survey team near {place} and get them out.
Reach the people trapped at {place}.
Break through to {place} and bring the survivors back.
stakes: They won't last another night out there.
I'm begging you. There's no one else to send.
If they die out there, {hub} will never trust Union pilots again.
question: Will the squad reach the survivors in time?

title: Trouble Followed You
Unwanted Attention
Loose Ends
objective: Deal with the people who caught you snooping.
Shake off the {enemy} who followed you back from your digging.
stakes: They know your faces now.
If this isn't handled, nobody here will talk to you again.
question: Can you deal with this before it follows you home?

title: Rightful Owners
Hot Merchandise
They Want It Back
objective: The owners of what you bought have come to collect. Stop them, or make it right.
stakes: Lose this and you lose the gear, and your name at the market.
question: Do you keep what you bought, or make it right?

title: Off-Plan
Bad Deal
Everything Goes Sideways
objective: Get out of the mess your last deal made, near {place}.
stakes: If this goes badly, the deal and everyone in it goes down with you.
question: Can you save the deal, or just yourselves?

title: Keeping the Lights On
Hostile Takeover
The Organization Needs You
objective: Your organization is in trouble. Defend its interests at {place}.
stakes: Fail, and the organization you built may not survive the season.
question: Will your organization survive the season?

title: Paying Back {patron}
A Favor Owed
Calling It In
objective: I'm calling in the favor you owe. I need {place} dealt with.
stakes: Do this and the debt is clear. Refuse, and my people remember.
question: Will you pay what you owe?

title: Safe Conduct
Get Them Out
The Passenger
objective: Get my envoy from {place} to safety.
Escort a witness out of {place} before {enemy} silence them.
stakes: If the envoy dies, the talks die with them.
{enemy} will do anything to stop this person reaching {hub}.
question: Will the envoy reach {hub} alive, and who tipped off {enemy}?

title: Mayday
Distress Call
Signal from {place}
objective: Answer a distress signal from {place}. The sender didn't say who they are.
Find out who is calling for help from {place}, and help them if you can.
stakes: Whoever sent it is running out of time.
Nobody else is close enough to answer.
question: Who sent the signal, and can the squad get there before {enemy} do?

title: Follow the Lead
A Name and a Place
Checking It Out
objective: An informant says {enemy} are using {place}. Go and see.
Follow up a tip about what's really happening at {place}.
stakes: If the tip is good, this changes everything. If it's bad, it's a trap.
I trust the informant. You don't have to.
question: Is the tip true, and who wanted you to hear it?

title: The Wreck at {place}
Old Bones
Derelict
objective: Search the long-abandoned wreck at {place} and bring back what's worth bringing.
Get into the derelict at {place} and secure its core.
stakes: Whatever is inside, {enemy} want it too.
Nobody who went in last time came out the same.
question: What is in the wreck, and is it worth what it costs to get?

title: Bring It Down
Demolition
Cut the Line
objective: Bring down the bridge at {place} before {enemy} can use it.
Destroy the relay at {place} and cut {enemy} off.
stakes: Leave it standing and {enemy} roll straight into {hub}.
It's the only way across. Once it's gone, it's gone for everyone.
question: Can the squad bring it down, and who gets hurt when it falls?

title: Make Some Noise
The Distraction
Look Over Here
objective: Draw {enemy} to {place} and keep them busy while another team does the real work.
Start a fight at {place} loud enough to pull every patrol away.
stakes: The other team is counting on you lasting long enough.
If {enemy} see through it, both teams are finished.
question: Can the squad hold {enemy}'s attention long enough?

title: Take and Hold
Secure {place}
Lockdown
objective: Secure {place} and hold it until my people arrive.
Take {place} from {enemy}, intact.
stakes: Whoever holds {place} controls the valley.
I need it standing, not burning.
question: Will {place} be in friendly hands when the dust settles?

title: Quiet Delivery
Through the Lines
No Questions
objective: Get a shipment of {cargo} through {place} without it being seized.
Run {cargo} past {enemy}'s patrols at {place}.
stakes: If it's seized, I'm finished, and so is your welcome here.
Someone on the other side is waiting for this, and they can't wait long.
question: Will the {cargo} get through, and do you want to know what it's for?

title: Hunting Lancers
The Other Squad
Reputation
objective: Track down the lancer squad working for {enemy} and stop them.
Find the pilots who hit {place} and end their run.
stakes: They're good. As long as they're out there, {hub} isn't safe.
Beat them and every crew in the sector will know your names.
question: Who's the better squad?

title: Last Transports Out
Evacuation
Buy Them Time
objective: Cover the evacuation of {place} until the last transport is away.
Hold {enemy} off while {place} empties.
stakes: Every minute you hold is another family out.
If the line breaks, the transports are sitting targets.
question: How many get out?

title: Extraction
Jailbreak
The Inside Job
objective: Get someone out of {place}: they're being held by {enemy}.
Break into {place}, find the prisoner, and get them out.
stakes: They know things {enemy} can't let leave.
If you fail, they won't get another chance.
question: Can the squad get them out, and are they who {patron} says they are?

title: The Night Train
Iron Road
Hold the Train
objective: Get the ore train through {place} with {enemy} riding hard behind it.
Stop {enemy} from taking the supply train at {place}.
stakes: That train is the whole season's pay for {hub}.
If the train goes over, so does the bridge, and {hub} is cut off for months.
question: Will the train reach {hub}?

title: Trial by Combat
The Champion's Field
A Matter of Honor
objective: Stand as my champions against the lancers {enemy} have hired.
Settle the dispute over {place} on the field, mech against mech.
stakes: By custom, whoever loses the field loses the claim.
My name, and the people under it, ride on this.
question: Whose claim will the field decide for?

title: Offline
The Vault Job
Hard Copy
objective: Hold the server stack at {place} while my people pull the data.
Hit the corporate data vault at {place} and keep {enemy} off the extraction team.
stakes: What's on those drives could bring a tower down.
If {enemy} lock the vault, nobody gets another try.
question: Will the data get out, and who wants it buried?

title: The Festival Watch
Keep the Lanterns Lit
Sanctuary
objective: Guard {place} through the festival night: {enemy} have promised to burn it.
Protect the pilgrims at {place} until the ceremony ends.
stakes: Lose the shrine and {hub} loses more than a building.
Thousands will be in the streets tonight.

title: First Drop: Live-Fire Drill
objective: Take your Everests onto the range and put down the training drones, one lesson at a time.
stakes: Nobody dies today. But this is where you learn whether you're ready for the real thing.

title: The Fight Comes Home
Hold the Streets
Raid on {hub}

title: Standoff at {spot}
Showdown
Guns Out in {hub}

The street outside {spot} is full of {enemy}. Fight your way out.

Boarding Action

Board the {enemy} gunship and take her intact.
